summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the Network Stream (নেটওয়ার্ক স্ট্রিম) feature in NestTube: dedicated page (/network-stream) supporting both direct stream URLs (.m3u8, .mp4) and full M3U playlist files, real-time M3U stream sniffer, Firestore profile cloud synchronization for cross-device access with IndexedDB guest fallback, custom stream history manager, and seamless HlsLivePlayer playback.
